input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: A full read of the Agreement (including the fees/revenue-share provision in Section 5 and searches for "most favoured/favored", "no less favourable" and best-terms language) shows no most-favoured-nation or best-terms obligation anywhere. To the contrary, Section 1 confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and expressly preserves AP's freedom to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties, so AP has no duty to extend Kubient terms matching those given to others or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); no Vendor-granted MFN exists in our favour, which is a commercial upside point rather than a playbook deviation. No redline required.
